text: The number of 4 digit numbers having their digits in non-decreasing order (from left to right) constructed by using the digits belonging to the set {1, 2, 3} is ______.
solution: A 4-digit non-decreasing string is fixed by how many 1s, 2s and 3s it uses: x1 + x2 + x3 = 4 with xi >= 0, giving C(4+3-1, 3-1) = C(6,2) = 15. This is IODB (identical digits into 3 labelled values) in disguise.
source_label: GATE Overflow discussion of GATE CS 2015 Set 3 Q.5 (answer 15)
